result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Company may assign without consent to an affiliate or qualifying successor; Contractor remains subject to Company consent, not to be unreasonably withheld, and cannot assign to a Company competitor; no termination right is added for a Company change of control. The revision preserves the original allocation otherwise and is professionally drafted. It is not strictly minimal because it also permits assignment in connection with a “reorganization,” which is broader than the specified preferred carve-out and unnecessary given the affiliate-assignment right.
